edits.current: COMPOSITE FIELD - the beneficiary's location block of the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025): address, department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, and country. COUNTRY IS ALWAYS MANDATORY. Address, department and municipality are mandatory only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia only the country is reported and address, department and municipality are left empty. The country here is the country of the beneficiary's address, not a tax-residence marker. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE: Employee.Department_Code and Employee.Municipality_Code, held as DIVIPOLA codes in the employee master data, with the address and the country taken from the same employee address record; where the master data holds a letter department code and a free-text city, the codes are obtained through the DIVIPOLA mapping table, maintained as a configuration table that maps each master-data department letter code and city name to its DANE department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) code, every entry validated against the DIVIPOLA catalogue. Free text must never be sent in the department, municipality or country sub-fields. Location is retained for leavers and held for employer-paid pensioners.

edits.current: The fiscal year whose payments are reported (AAAA). Every amount numeral (5 to 33) is the sum of payments or credits in account made between 1 January and 31 December of this year, by PAYMENT date - never a rolling twelve-month window or an accumulator spanning two calendar years. Filed in May or June of the FOLLOWING calendar year.
edits.proposed: The fiscal year whose payments are reported (AAAA). Every amount numeral (5 to 33) is the sum of payments or credits in account made between 1 January and 31 December of this year, by PAYMENT date - never a rolling twelve-month window or an accumulator spanning two calendar years. Filed in May or June of the FOLLOWING calendar year. In the XML header (element Cab, Anexo T3.45) the tax year is carried by FecInicial and FecFinal - the first and last day of the tax year reported, format AAAA-MM-DD - while the header attribute Ano is the YEAR OF SENDING (año de envío, the same aaaa as in the file name), not the tax year: for the 2026 return filed in 2027, Ano = 2027, FecInicial = 2026-01-01 and FecFinal = 2026-12-31.
edits.reason: The spec maps the tax year to a single AAAA value; the annex carries the sending year in Ano and the tax year as a date range. Without this a developer may write the tax year into Ano.
edits.basis: Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025 (Especificaciones Técnicas Formato 2276 v4, Diario Oficial 53.254 of 25 Sep 2025) section 2.1 (Ano, FecInicial, FecFinal)

edits.current: Informant NIT | Taxpayer category (Gran Taxpayer / legal entity / natural person) | Tax year | Format 2276 version 4
edits.proposed: Informant NIT | Taxpayer category (Gran Taxpayer / legal entity / natural person) | Tax year | Format 2276 version 4. In the XML the header element Cab carries, all mandatory (Anexo T3.45 section 2.1): Ano (year of sending, AAAA), CodCpt (1 = insertion, 2 = replacement), Formato (2276), Version (4), NumEnvio (consecutive number of the sending within the year, up to 8 digits), FecEnvio (AAAA-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), FecInicial and FecFinal (first and last day of the tax year reported, AAAA-MM-DD), ValorTotal (control total - defined by the annex as the sum of the attribute tdocb across the records) and CantReg (number of rentra records in the file, at most 5,000). The informant NIT and the taxpayer category are not header attributes: they come from the portal session and drive the deadline.
edits.reason: The logical envelope omits the physical header attributes the annex makes mandatory; the client's Excel has none of them, so the developer has no other source.
edits.basis: Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025 (Especificaciones Técnicas Formato 2276 v4, Diario Oficial 53.254 of 25 Sep 2025) section 2.1

summary: 46 proposed cell edits, all supported by Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025 (Formato 2276 v4) or art. 1.3.7.1.1: field lengths aligned to the annex (amount attributes 18, identification numbers 20, fideicomiso 14, entinfo 2), the country sub-field documented as a numeric code (169 = Colombia), the XML header (Ano = year of sending; FecInicial/FecFinal = tax year) added to ENV-03 and File Structure, numeral 33 'blank' corrected to 'zero', and an employer-paid pensioner YES row for the Payroll Scope Summary. No Field Explanation rule was changed to follow the client's file; the client's deviations (thousand rounding, meal allowance in numeral 7, numeral 33 population, missing first names) are listed under not_applied.
